lines.text: The Amalekites raided the Negev and burned Ziklag down, and David's men found their families taken captive.
David's wives Ahinoam and Michal were captured, and David found strength in the LORD.
David and his six hundred men reached the Brook of Besor, where three hundred men were too exhausted to cross.
David struck down the Amalekites from twilight until the next evening, and he recovered everything they had taken.
David ruled that the one who went to battle and the one who stayed with the supplies would share alike.
